name: Social Injustice
overview: Scripture commands believers to uphold righteousness in judgment without partiality, emphasizing impartiality toward both the poor and the mighty as seen in Leviticus 19:15. God's Word calls His people to actively defend the vulnerable by pleading the cause of the poor, the fatherless, and the widow, as urged in Proverbs 31:9 and Isaiah 1:17. The heart of social injustice is exposed in Psalms 64:6, revealing the depth of inward sin that must be addressed with gentle and wise speech, following the counsel of Proverbs 15:1. Ultimately, God's revelation in Exodus 20:1 grounds these commands in His holy authority, calling His people to live justly and compassionately.
